The patient's worsening headache and the presence of a layered hypodense crescent-shaped extra-axial collection on the noncontrast CT of the head are consistent with a subdural hematoma, particularly given the history of recent cesarean delivery under spinal anesthesia.

Although less likely, an epidural hematoma could also present with similar symptoms, but the description of the collection as 'layered hypodense crescent-shaped' and the absence of a clear mention of a biconvex shape or other specific epidural hematoma characteristics make this diagnosis less probable.
